reviews.title: Rude staff
reviews.text: The staff at Suwanabuni airport at gate E10 was very rude and shouted at the passengers without any reason. Very discriminating and disrespectful.
reviews.author: Janet

reviews.title: Do not recommend this airline
reviews.text: I purchased premium economy hoping for extra space than in economy. The seats were exactly the same width as economy seats but had slightly more leg room. The plane was very old and the seat back had a very large gap between the seat back and seat bottom. Very uncomfortable. The safety standards were woeful. The man in front of me brought onboard 4 bags which occupied 2 seats surrounding him. Proper safety regulations were not followed. And 2 men from economy just helped themselves to premium economy seats. I had to cancel my flight from Yangon to Singapore due to the mandatory quarantine imposed by Singapore for people coming from Myanmar which occurred whilst I was in Myanmar. My ticket permitted a cancellation and the airline acknowledged my cancellation and confirmed I was entitled to a full refund. Almost 3 months later I have not received a refund and each time I follow this up with the airline they advise their accounts team have been requested to issue a refund. Clearly they have no intention of issuing a refund and like most other airlines just fob off customers. Very disappointed with their service but their planes and lack of safety protocol is more concerning. My flight cost over $600 AUD and I consider their flight very poor value given the age of the plane.
reviews.author: Suntanner71

reviews.title: Not reliable-flight times change often
reviews.text: Flights times changed twice in a few days. Seems very common. But new departure times are +4 or 5 hours. That makes things and travel plans hard. Lost all tickets to BKK and Europe with no chance de get refund/flight change on MNA. No trust in this carrier and already booked on KBZ for next ones (more reliable). Staff very nice however.
reviews.author: Christophe S

reviews.title: Good and friendly service, seats not comfortable in C-class
reviews.text: I was a bit concerned if the airline would be up to a proper standard in Business Class but was very pleased with the service. The boarding was a bit chaotic at the gate but otherwise relaxed and easy. The service on board was very friendly and attentive. Food was average though. The old-fashioned recliner seats were not very comfortable. There was a nice surprise on arrival in Yangon: They provide a personal escort service helping premium passengers with immigration and luggage and they even provide a free transfer service to the hotel. Altogether a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: Jorn Horaczek

reviews.title: quick good flight
reviews.text: Nice cabin personell and seemed to be quite a new airplane. Everything worked fine on this short flight back to Yangon.
reviews.author: Saara P

reviews.title: Brilliant Airline
reviews.text: Loved the drama of a plane with propellers. A great, punctual and highly polished outfit. Flying as it once was. Didn't know much about the airline prior to going to Myanmar. Small in flight meal too. Would fly with them again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Richard B

reviews.title: Three flights, all on time no issues
reviews.text: Booked three internal flights with them. Online booking and payment was easy, e-tickets received and printed four months before travel. Only one minor 20 minutes schedule charge advised to us by email a week prior. All flights took off on time, despite the short one hour flight, tea, coffee or a soft drink with a cake was always served. Check in lines always moved quickly, seemed much more so than the rival three airlines. Efficient and friendly.
reviews.author: Kevin S

reviews.title: Myanmar National Airlines
reviews.text: I was very surprised to find it a very good flight. In spite of it being a short flight they gave cakes and sweets and cold drinks. The staff was very good. It was indeed a very pleasant surprise
reviews.author: Zarin S

reviews.title: Two Broken ankles were not too much trouble
reviews.text: In January 2020, my wife two teenage daughters and I were travelling in Myanmar and while in Mandalay my wife had an accident on a boat. We eventually learned she broke both ankles (one requiring surgery and 7 screws). So we needed to leave Mandalay directly fr home and was able to book a flight on Myanmar National Airlines. It worked brilliantly. I managed to order a wheelchair online and they were prompt and really helpful with my wife on both ends of the flight. The service was outstanding both for her and the rest of us (and the whole flight). The catering was quite good (better by far than most airlines) and the 737 only had 29 rows (as opposed to Qantas's 30) which meant that my knees did not jam up against the seat in front of me. Given the circumstances I just needed to get my family out of Mandalay. Myanmar National Airlines did far more than that - comfortables, helpful and tasteful. I would choose them again.
reviews.author: GregoryPick

reviews.title: Great experience overall
reviews.text: We had an awesome experience overall. From Singapore where staff took great care to the flight on to Mandalay and Bagan. Friendly and helpful staff. Attention to details. I recommend them anytime. They have a great network of flights around the country and connections to near by big hubs
reviews.author: Jorge Estrada Chacon

reviews.title: On time flights on all my three flights
reviews.text: I booked this airlines for my internal flights from yangon-nyaung-u-mandalay-yangon.all my three flights were through this airlines and all the three flights were on time.Though the flights were short duration flights,they offered on board snacks which though limited, was quite satisfactory. I recommend this airline for everybody who wish to fly within myanmar
reviews.author: devina1991

reviews.title: Booked due to rave reviews and did not disappoint.
reviews.text: Great full service airline. Small turbo prop ATR-72 but aircraft was only 2 years. 2-2 configuration with about 18 rows. Meal service wasn’t much, but better than nothing. Short flight anyway. Service was amazing. Very safe airline. My only issue was that the moved the flight forward 50 minutes and we didn’t get a notification. Luckily we were there early.
reviews.author: Peter D

reviews.title: Delay
reviews.text: I flew in the beginning of december and the flight das delayed because there were some irresponsible late passengers that didn't come in. If there is a boarding time it must be respected. All other passengers had to wait too much time.
reviews.author: Marcio M

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: This was a comfortable flight with friendly staff. Good leg space, provided on board meals. Safe airline to fly with
reviews.author: HGC_13

reviews.title: Smooth
reviews.text: It was my first time traveling to Myanmar so I didn't know what to expect. The flight took off and landed as scheduled (there was good weather that day). The ramp agents were polite and helpful. Just after take off it got very cold than I noticed that it started to warm they must have turned the heat on. The flight was only 55 min but a meal with coffee was served. I wish they went more places If they did I would fly with them.
reviews.author: alivingston2002

reviews.title: Very bad customer service at check in counter at Singapore
reviews.text: Very bad customer service at check in counter. No respect to customer at all . I don’t know the staff name however she is very obvious person among staffs . She is quite big body structure. I asked her to use cable tide for bag. She asked me back do it yourself
reviews.author: Julia

reviews.title: My experience(s) with MNA (Myanmar National Airlines)
reviews.text: Myanmar National Airlines can be regarded as the most secure airline in Myanmar. Plus, it has flights to most part of the country. My impression on this airline is the significantly smooth landing and taking-off (compared to other airlines in Myanmar). The condition of aircraft is obviously safer and more comfortable (again compared to other airlines in Myanmar). Also, they offer food and beverages in all their flights even if it is a 35-minute one, as far as I have experienced. Yet, I notice that the quality of food has been really low lately and this would be the only big dissatisfaction so far from me.
reviews.author: Chit Su

reviews.title: Nothing spectacular or to complain about.
reviews.text: Booked a flight from Inle Lake back to Yangon via Yangon Airways, but due to low seat capacity, was transferred to Myanmar Airways. Airport at Heho was far away from the nearest town and the airport was in derelict condition. Seems like it has not been renovated for more than a hundred years and the equipment that they are using a really old. Even the weighing scales are the manual sort of scales. Lot of flies and mosquitoes at the airport and they even allowed liquids and water to be hand carried. Surprisingly, the plane left more than half an hour before its scheduled take-off, which was good for me, but not sure bout those who might have arrived at the airport late. Flight was okay, plane appears to be in a serviceable condition and some bread and drinks were served during the short 1 hour flight to Yangon.
reviews.author: Malcolm S.

reviews.title: Good flight from Yangon to Hong Kong
reviews.text: This nonstop flight was a very goof choice from Yangon, compared to the many other choices that entailed a stop-over. It was on-time and the ervice was very good.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.title: Uncomplicated flight
reviews.text: Travelled on late evening flight. Initially scheduled for 520pm but re scheduled to 750pm. Despite rain, flight left on time. Air bridge in NYT, bus in RGN. New 737-800 series, with pleasant fabric seats. Despite very short flight (40 mins), crew served sandwiches and hot drinks.
reviews.author: mostlyharmless

reviews.title: One option for travel to Bangkok.
reviews.text: Several airlines fly from Yangon to Bangkok. MNA is worth trying among them. With MNA I could arrive in Bangkok earlier.
reviews.author: TM Hlaing

reviews.title: The best airlines in Myanmar
reviews.text: Good service and comfortable seat . Foods are clean and fresh. i always fly with MNA. Perfect pilot, safe flight and kindly staff are great.
reviews.author: diamond_voyage

reviews.title: MNA is the best airline in Myanmar
reviews.text: - Very punctual - Service is good - Only one thing, the food served should be Myanmar Traditional Food
reviews.author: Thiha1992

reviews.title: Efficent and Clean
reviews.text: Fast efficient, great helpful staff and well maintained. The airport for domestic flights is amazingly large with plenty of places to sit the shopping facilities are not too over priced. If you are a smoker be warned in Myanmar they are still strict to confiscate your lighters.
reviews.author: Craig S

reviews.title: Average airline
reviews.text: The plane was a bit worn off and dirty, my tray was not working properly. Emergency exit making a super weird noise during take-off, so we got a little bit scared. But the staff was super nice and helpful, made sure the cabin pressure was fine and calmed us down a bit.
reviews.author: La Checa

reviews.title: Always been a pleasure to fly MNA...
reviews.text: Cheerful service and food is nice. Timings are great as you can get the night flight also that you don't have to take leave for that day. Schedule is always on time no delay at all. I fly at least 3 times a year every year and never encountered a single delay. Keep it up guys!
reviews.author: Myat

reviews.title: better than expected
reviews.text: Our first flight was delayed by 3 hours from Bangkok and with no representative from Myanmar on hand there was some concern about this airline but all was good once we were on board., assigned the emergency exit which was a surprise when seating, plenty of leg room, storage and comfortable seat for the 1 hour flight. The plane was only 3 years old so everything was clean and in good condition. The FA was attentive, good command of English. A snack of a sandwich together with a cold drink was served and the flight arrived within the hour. Our return flight left on time and we had a similar service. Yes, I would fly with MNA again.
reviews.author: QueenslandTommy

reviews.title: Did not know what to expect, but I was very pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: I did not know what to expect, as the predecessor of Myanmar National Airlines had a bad reputation, but after doing some research decided to take them to travel from Yangon to Naypidaw and I was very pleasantly surprised. The check-in counters were a bit crowded, but the process was efficient so the line moved quickly, and the Yangon domestic terminal looks brand new. Going through security was a breeze, and there are many good café options to spend the time until boarding. Buses are always more inconvenient, but in this case it was actually nice to see the planes parked on the tarmac. Aircraft was originally scheduled to be E-190, but was up-gauged to B737NG, and the plane looked brand new and was spotless. The Myanmar National Airlines branding on the outside and inside looks very smart but still professional, and the Sky Interior on the inside gives it a very nice touch, with different lighting, etc. The flight was only 30 minutes, but we received a small snack box (nothing to write home about, but a nice detail nonetheless), and we were on time to Naypidaw. So, again, a very pleasant surprise and would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: MarkamBey

reviews.title: Not sure is this a low cost
reviews.text: I booked this fright through Expedia. My friend booked MAI airline which is a Myanmar airline too. I thought I would arrived in Yangon before my friend but turned out I arrived 1/2 hour later than my friend. The airline didn't give any reason of delay. So, I thought this is like a low cost airline but I paid the full fare! A bit disappointed.
reviews.author: philipyu9

reviews.title: Negative - Last Minute Flight Change
reviews.text: We arranged a late afternoon flight from Dawei to Yangon on 19 Mar for our crew. On the flight day itself, MNA announced at the very last minute that the flight is canceled and all passengers were transferred to an earlier flight. All our arrangements for connecting flights, hotels, etc. for our crew are disrupted because of this last minute change. We have to pay more for the changes in flights and hotels. Terrible service from MNA!
reviews.author: Amin
